# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good intent, and keep discussion about the work. Harassment, personal attacks, and discriminatory language are not accepted in issues, pull requests, or any other project space.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior through the contact form at [marcopontili.com/contact](https://marcopontili.com/contact). Reports are read by the maintainer and kept confidential. The maintainer may remove comments, close threads, or block accounts that break this code, following the enforcement guidelines of the Covenant.
